QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_24

question.text: A Cat III AIF has Capital Rs. 100 crore, Hurdle 8%, Incentive 20%. Year 1 NAV pre-incentives is Rs. 116 crore. What is the incentive fee payable?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook charges incentive fees as the stated percentage of return over the reference hurdle. Reference hurdle for Year 1 is 100 x 1.08 = Rs. 108 crore. Excess over the hurdle is 116 - 108 = Rs. 8 crore. Incentive fee at 20% of excess is 0.20 x 8 = Rs. 1.60 crore. The Trap: Rs. 3.20 crore doubles the rate; Rs. 16 crore applies 20% to the full Rs. 80 crore-style gain ignoring the hurdle; Rs. 10 crore is arbitrary. Note: Per workbook pages 172-173 and 175.
